items.title_zh: MOABB v1.7.1 发布

bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through proxy or HTTP transport failures.
It catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries.
The release preserves default auto provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.1增强离线缓存与NEMAR容错，提升基准可用性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 improves offline cache and NEMAR fault tolerance for benchmark usability.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

bullets_zh: MOABB 提交 #1169 更新基准测试流程，在预取 NEMAR 前使用缓存数据。
该变更避免对已缓存数据集进行不必要的 NEMAR 预取，并在移除缓存后保留 NEMAR 优先行为。
其意义在于 MOABB 支持非侵入式 BCI 基准评测，尤其是基于 EEG 的工作流。
bullets_en: MOABB commit #1169 updates the benchmark pipeline to use cached data before prefetching NEMAR.
The change avoids unnecessary NEMAR prefetch for cached datasets and preserves NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal.
It matters because MOABB supports non-invasive BCI benchmark evaluation, especially EEG-based workflows.
items.brief: MOABB基准更新：预取NEMAR前优先使用缓存，优化非侵入式BCI评测数据流程。
items.brief_en: MOABB benchmark update uses cached data before prefetching NEMAR to improve non-invasive BCI evaluation workflows.
items.raw_excerpt: Use cached data before prefetching NEMAR (#1169) * Avoid NEMAR prefetch for cached data * Preserve NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal

The update supports ongoing maintenance of MOABB's non-invasive EEG BCI benchmark datasets.

items.title_zh: MOABB v1.6.1 发布

该版本修复了BNCI2025_001原始EEG读取中的标签泄漏问题。

It fixes label leakage in BNCI2025_001 raw EEG reading.
The update helps maintain trustworthy benchmark evaluation on MOABB datasets.

items.brief_en: MOABB v1.6.1 fixes data label leakage to maintain trustworthy benchmark evaluation.

items.title_zh: MOABB 预发布 1.6.1 版本
bullets_zh: NeuroTechX MOABB 于 2026-08-27 标记了 1.6.1 预发布版本。
该提交更新了包文件、引用记录、README 和文档中的版本元数据。
它滚动更新变更日志，使 1.6.1 成为稳定版并开启 1.7 源码周期。
bullets_en: NeuroTechX MOABB tagged a 1.6.1 pre-release on 2026-08-27.
The commit bumps version metadata across package files, citation records, README and docs.
It rolls the changelog so 1.6.1 becomes stable while opening the 1.7 source cycle.
items.brief: MOABB 预发布 1.6.1，更新版本元数据并开启 1.7 周期。
items.brief_en: MOABB pre-releases version 1.6.1, updating metadata and changelog while opening the next 1.7 source cycle.
items.raw_excerpt: Pre-release 1.6.1 (#1167) Bump the version to 1.6.1 across moabb/__init__.py, CITATION.cff, README.md and docs/source/cite.rst, and roll the changelog: the 1.6.1 section becomes '(Stable - PyPi)' and a fresh 'Version 1.7 (Source - GitHub)' opens.

items.title_zh: MOABB 从 channel_types 派生 n_channels
bullets_zh: 修改 AcquisitionMetadata，使 n_channels 从 channel_types 派生。
移除可能与通道类型不一致的冗余存储字段。
提升 MOABB 数据集元数据在 BCI 基准评测中的一致性。
bullets_en: Changes AcquisitionMetadata to derive n_channels from channel_types.
Removes redundant stored field that could disagree with channel types.
Improves consistency of MOABB dataset metadata for BCI benchmarking.
items.brief: MOABB元数据修复，提升EEG-BCI基准数据集通道信息一致性。
items.brief_en: MOABB metadata fix improving channel-information consistency in EEG/BCI benchmark datasets.
items.raw_excerpt: Derive AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels from channel_types instead of storing it (#1166) AcquisitionMetadata stored n_channels next to channel_types, which describes the same fact. items.title_zh: [NeuroTechX/moabb] 修复 BNCI2025_001 标签泄露及 NEMAR 预取防护
items.title_en: [NeuroTechX/moabb] Fix label leakage in BNCI2025_001 and NEMAR prefetch guard
bullets_zh: 修复 BNCI2025_001 数据集中的关键标签泄露问题，运动学通道被错误分类为 EEG 特征。
更新 gh-700 的导联处理并实施 NEMAR 预取防护以防止数据错误。
确保使用 MOABB 框架进行非侵入式 EEG 分类任务的基准完整性。
bullets_en: Fixes critical label leakage in BNCI2025_001 dataset where kinematic channels were misclassified as EEG features.
Updates montage handling for gh-700 and implements NEMAR prefetch guard to prevent data errors.
Ensures benchmark integrity for non-invasive EEG classification tasks using MOABB framework.
items.brief: MOABB 基准修复 BNCI2025_001 标签泄露，确保非侵入式 EEG 分类数据完整性。
items.brief_en: MOABB benchmark update fixes label leakage in BNCI2025_001, ensuring data integrity for non-invasive EEG classification.
items.raw_excerpt: Fix label leakage in BNCI2025_001, the montages gh-700 never shipped, and the NEMAR prefetch guard (#1161) - BNCI2025_001: type the 7 kinematic channels (target position, hand velocity) as misc. read_raw_eeglab typed them eeg, so every paradigm fed the labels to the classifier as features. EOG named explicitly so the declared channel_types is true by construction. - Rodrigues2017, Cattan2019_PHMD

items.title_zh: MOABB v1.6.0 版本发布
bullets_zh: MOABB于2026年8月26日发布v1.6.0，包含来自21位贡献者的68次提交和81条更新日志。
该版本扩展了基准数据集并更新了EEG/BCI评估库。
它作为标准非侵入式BCI基准平台的重要更新而值得关注。
bullets_en: MOABB released v1.6.0 on 2026-08-26 with 68 commits and 81 changelog entries from 21 contributors.
The release expands benchmark datasets and updates the EEG/BCI evaluation library.
It matters as a major update to a standard non-invasive BCI benchmarking platform.
items.brief: MOABB v1.6.0发布，扩展EEG/BCI基准数据集与评估库。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.6.0 expands EEG/BCI benchmark datasets and evaluation library.
